content:
Select Need help? in the Microsoft Defender portal to contact Microsoft support about
provisioning Microsoft Defender XDR in a different data center location.
Once the service is provisioned, it adds:
Incidents management
Alerts queue
An action center for managing automated investigation and response
Advanced hunting capabilities
Threat analytics
Microsoft Defender portal with incidents management and other capabilities
To enable the integration with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, you'll need to log in
to the Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps at least once.
７ Note
In the past, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint automatically provisioned in European
Union (EU) data centers when turned on through Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
Microsoft Defender XDR will automatically provision in the same EU data center for
customers who have provisioned Defender for Endpoint in this manner in the past.
